contentText:
Karol G continues to remain on top for a sixth week with “BbY WOW,” while LATIN MAFIA and Fred again.. see a new high in the top 10 with “Te Estoy Correteando,” and Rauw Alejandro enters into the top 10 with “Macacoa 2000.”

Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 chart for the week dated Oct. 3! “Alguien Que Te Amaba” opens the countdown at No. 10. Rauw Alejandro’s Grand Theft Auto VI synch debuts at No. 9. “De Lejitos” keeps its hold at eight, “Matadora” dips to seven, as does “Koko” to six, and “Ayúdame” to five. LATIN MAFIA and Fred again.. reach the top five at No. 4, “Ahí” is untouchable at three, as is “DTMF” at two and “BbY WOW” owns the crown with a sixth week at No. 1!
